nodes.label: Calculator Interface
nodes.description: Two number inputs, an operation selector, an equals button, and a result readout. Collects the two values and the chosen operation and sends them to the logic node.

nodes.label: Calculator Logic
nodes.description: Takes the two numbers and the selected operation. Validates that both are real numbers, performs the addition, subtraction, multiplication or division, and returns the result. Guards against dividing by zero.

nodes.label: Validation & Error Handling
nodes.description: Checks the inputs are valid numbers before calculating. If a value is empty, not a number, or division by zero is attempted, it returns a clear error message instead of a broken result.

nodes.label: Results Display
nodes.description: Shows the answer from the logic node, or the friendly error message. Keeps the screen readable and reveals the result clearly after the equals button is pressed.
